description:
Summary:

Pure refactor. The per-result `compile_result.make_launcher()` call plus its catch of `OutOfResources` / `PTXASError` / `torch.cuda.OutOfMemoryError` / `IntelGPUError` was the inner body of `_make_launchers` (plural). Hoist into `_make_launcher` (singular), returning a `(launcher, exc)` tuple where exactly one side is non-None. `_make_launchers` then loops over compile results and accumulates successes vs latest exception identically to before.

The DeviceGuard scope around the loop is preserved: callers of the new `_make_launcher` must hold a DeviceGuard themselves (the docstring says so). Only `_make_launchers` calls it for now; the incremental autotune plugin downstream reuses it from its own DeviceGuard-wrapped paths.

Behaviour preserved: same successful-launcher list (in the same order), same final `exc` retained for the all-launchers-failed error message, same `compile_by_disabling_pipelining` fallback when the last launcher fails with an OOM-like exception on a multi-stage kernel.

Test Plan:
```
buck test fbcode//mode/opt fbcode//caffe2/test/inductor:triton_heuristics
```
